newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called weaker, palladium down.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called weaker, palladium down.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open flat to weaker Thursday, but dealers expected palladium and platinum to see sharp falls as they moved in line with overnight losses.

June NYMEX palladium was called down $4.00 to $6.00 from Wednesday's close of $180.10 an ounce. Concerns over Russian supplies appeared to be crumbling slightly following statements Wednesday that exports of white metals will start soon and, overall for 1997, volumes will be similar to 1996.
COMEX June gold was called flat to off $0.50 from Wednesday's close of $343.70.
